_about: Image-by-image review of assets/originals. Edit and rerun `npm run assets:organize`. Titles are working titles taken from what is visible in each photograph — Kyla should rename them. Nothing here states fabrics, sizes or prices; only visible features are described. Category values are folder paths under assets/processed. 'publish' controls whether the import creates a published listing; 'showcase' is masterpiece | signature | null. 'details' are close-up crops cut from the original photograph (x, y, w, h in original pixels). showcase_rank orders the signature gowns (lower first).

images.title: Teal Beaded Sweetheart Gown
images.visible: Strapless gown on a dress form. Pleated sweetheart bodice in teal edged with gold beads, a beaded line across the waist, and a long gathered skirt that pools into a short train.

details.caption: Gold beading along the sweetheart neckline

images.notes: Shot in a kitchen; counters touch the skirt at waist height — check the cut-out at the counter line.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Hem, train and gold beading intact; counter line removed cleanly. A small yellow tag at the form neck is part of the original photograph.

images.title: Fuchsia Pearl Sweetheart Gown
images.visible: Strapless fuchsia gown on a dress form with a corseted, seamed bodice, pearl clusters along the neckline and waist, and a sheer flowing overskirt with a train.
images.notes: Sheer overskirt: verify transparency is kept rather than filled or clipped.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Pearl trim and the ruffled hem edge intact. The sheer overskirt is kept as fabric.

images.title: Ivory Pearl Drape Gown
images.visible: Strapless ivory gown on a dress form with a diagonal draped panel across the bodice, pearl clusters at the neckline and waist, and a long skirt with a train.
images.notes: White gown: could suit bridal or debut wear, but the photograph does not say so — left as an evening gown. Lower resolution (1080×1550) screenshot with a slight dark border.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Draped panel and pearl clusters intact; the screenshot border did not carry over.

images.title: Crimson Wing Formal Set
images.visible: Red satin long-sleeved top with a stand collar, crystal drops down the front, a sequined tulle panel sweeping across the body like a wing, and matching trousers.
images.people: Worn by a young pageant participant backstage (contestant rosette visible). May be a minor — confirm the family's consent before publishing widely.
images.notes: Cropped below the knee in the original, so it is presented as a half-length portrait.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Sequined wing panel and drops intact; the contestant rosette is pinned to the outfit and was kept.

images.title: Verdant Embroidered Formal Set
images.visible: Green satin long-sleeved top with gold and green floral embroidery, sequins and stones, a beaded fringe across the front, matching trousers, and a woven hat carried in hand.
images.people: Worn by a young pageant participant backstage. May be a minor — confirm consent before publishing widely.
images.notes: Heritage-inspired details, but no specific regional or national costume is claimed.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Embroidery, fringe and the woven hat intact.

images.title: Rose Bodice Pageant Gown
images.visible: Red gown with a bodice of sculpted fabric roses, one structured shoulder with beaded fringe, a beaded column skirt with a front slit, layered tulle train, and red lace gloves.
images.people: Worn by a young pageant contestant (rosette visible). May be a minor — confirm consent before publishing widely.
images.notes: Cropped at the knee in the original.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Rose bodice, fringe, gloves and tulle train intact.

images.title: Heritage Pageant Costume
images.visible: Heavily trimmed jacket and front panel in gold, rust and cream woven bands with large red stones, beaded chains and a matching headband.
images.people: Official portrait from a school event (Hari at Reyna ng Wika at Kasaysayan 2026, Liceo de Pakil) with the student's full name and grade printed on it. Not published: needs the student's and school's consent. The cut-out removes the printed name and logos, but the face remains.
images.notes: Heritage-themed pageant costume; no specific ethnic attribution is made.
images.cutout_review: Usable but imperfect: the bamboo pole held in the original was removed as background, leaving the hand closed around nothing. Not published.

images.title: Sunburst Headdress Costume
images.visible: Beaded green and gold bodysuit-style costume with wooden-bead and crystal fringes, a sheer embellished lower section, a velvet side panel, and a large sunburst headdress with red stones.
images.notes: Background is a composited green blur; the headdress edges need checking. Cropped at the thigh.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Headdress points, stones and bead fringes intact against the composited background.

images.title: Ember Beaded Gown
images.visible: Orange and red gown with capped shoulders, a bodice and hip panel of overlapping beaded teardrop motifs, a midriff cut-out with bead drops, and a sheer crystal-scattered skirt with a high slit.
images.notes: Already on a white studio backdrop. Similar framing to dress10 (same model and studio) but a different gown — not a duplicate.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Sheer beaded skirt and bead drops intact.

images.title: Gilded Fringe Gown
images.visible: Gold gown with a wide folded off-shoulder neckline edged in crystals and beaded fringe, gold appliqué at the bust, and a fitted sequined skirt flaring at the hem.
images.notes: Low resolution (768×960) — shown at modest sizes. Similar framing to dress9 but a different gown.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Beaded fringe at the neckline intact; low source resolution.

images.title: Red Sunburst Gown
images.visible: Red gown on a dress form with a high fan of pleated, glittered tulle at the neckline, voluminous puff sleeves, a beaded and sequined sunburst radiating from the waist, and a sweeping overskirt train.

details.caption: Sequined sunburst radiating from the waist

images.notes: Strongest silhouette and handwork in the set. Train runs off the bottom edge of the photograph.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Pleated tulle fan, puff sleeves and the overskirt train intact; dress form kept.

images.title: Fuchsia Sculpted Drape Gown
images.visible: Fuchsia one-shoulder gown with a sculpted pleated drape wrapping the bodice and hip, crystal bead fringe, a radiating beaded panel, a large crystal brooch, and a glittered overskirt.
images.notes: Second showpiece. Busy room behind; stair edge touches the skirt on the right.
images.cutout_review: Accepted. Crystal fringe and brooch intact; the stair edge was removed.

images.title: Tailored by Kyla logo
images.visible: White TK monogram and script wordmark on black.
images.notes: Brand asset, not clothing. Used by `npm run brand:assets`.
